verdict.rationale: Helicone documents Sessions that group related requests, a dashboard that tracks usage and costs, and Custom Properties as per-request metadata; properties are also usable for rate-limit and webhook filtering. However, no evidence explicitly shows cost or usage broken down per user, per session, or per custom property, and a community user notes Custom Properties hold only a little metadata. missing for 10: explicit docs on per-user/per-property cost attribution and breakdown views, user-ID tracking, independent hands-on corroboration of cost segmentation by metadata.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Sessions group these related requests together, letting you trace the entire agent flow from initial user input to final response in one unified view.
Track usage, costs, and performance across all providers in one dashboard
Control usage by request count, cost, or custom properties to manage expenses and prevent unintended overuse.
Custom Properties allow only a little metadata, not a big blob like a template.
